definition: the hard heavy wood of the acorn tree
description: A roof being built high above an old town at sunset. A bearded carpenter in a white helmet, white shirt, black waistcoat and safety harness stands on a huge square beam of pale solid oak that hangs from a crane hook, and swings an axe into it so wood chips fly. The cut end shows its tree rings clearly. The beam then comes to rest on a wooden post. Below him young apprentices in black hold wooden mallets on the scaffolding next to rows of new rafters, and a church spire rises behind.
